description:
Earth has produced an endless parade of animals, each with something extremely weird going on. Strange behaviours, odd physiology, and outlandish survival techniques can be found in every habitat. Each animal, in the competition to survive, has evolved a weird attribute to secure the winning edge. Across six episodes, Planet Weird uncovers some of the most extraordinary wild characters, each stranger than the last. Inside every weird story is a revelation of amazing adaptation and scientific surprise. We meet an endless array of colourful characters and discover that evolution is alive and ongoing, conjuring every conceivable way for life to succeed.
Planet Weird was produced by WildBear Entertainment for Love Nature and is presented by Ross Noble. Blue Ant Studios oversees international licensing.
